# Copilot Instructions

- Do not generate code outside the approved architecture.
- Do not hardcode credentials.
- Use UUID primary keys.
- Customer-owned records must include organization_id.
- Use Python type hints.
- Use TypeScript strict mode.
- Use Pydantic v2.
- Use SQLAlchemy 2.x syntax.
- Write tests for new behavior.
- Do not add dependencies without documenting them.
- Prefer clear code over unnecessary abstraction.
- Do not implement future features unless explicitly requested.
